resources.string: URGENT: I may need help. I have not responded to my safety check. This is an automatic alert from Virgil.
Tap to confirm you are OK
The following required permission(s) were revoked: %1$s. Virgil cannot alert your contacts until they are restored. Tap to review.
Tap to silence. Stops automatically after 5 minutes.
[Virgil TEST] This is a test from your safety app. No emergency — just checking that alerts and location work.
This will send a test SMS (clearly marked as a test) with your current location to %1$d emergency contact(s). No call will be placed.
Test message sent — check your contacts received it.
Test SMS sent, but location was unavailable. Check Android Settings → Location is on.
Virgil is a personal safety tool, not a medical device. It may miss falls or send false alerts. Stay as careful as you would without it.
